question.text: NGRBC was initially released as National Voluntary Guidelines (NVGs) in 2011 and subsequently revised in which year to align with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 6, the 2011 NVGs issued by MCA were revised in 2015 to align with International Standards and the Sustainable Development Goals. The SDGs were adopted in September 2015, which drove the revision. The Trap: 2013 saw Companies Act; 2018 saw SEBI ICDR reg change for SSE context; 2022 saw NSE-SSE and BSE-SSE launch. Only 2015 matches the NGRBC revision. Cross-Exam Context: III-A Compliance references MCA circulars; XII Securities Markets Foundation references the SDG adoption year. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Cite the 2015 revision version — if you cite NVG 2011, your AIR will look outdated to SSE diligence teams who expect SDG alignment.
